capabilities: Browse the vault in an expandable directory tree with drag-and-drop moves
Filter and sort a file list by name, time, size, or extension
Preview DOCX, XLSX, and PPTX documents without external applications
Preview code files with Prism.js syntax highlighting and line numbers
Show a note's forward links and embedded files in a reference list
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not a read-only viewer; it also creates, deletes, renames by drag-and-drop, and moves files and folders.
extras: Desktop only (depends on the Electron shell); requires Obsidian v1.5.0+; pending listing in the Community plugins store; supported by BRAT manual install.
motivation: The README says its key feature is separating documents from files, so writers can focus on writing while finding related files more easily.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer mixes notes with other files and cannot preview Office documents, making non-note files hard to find and view without external apps.
summary: File browser panel with a directory tree, sortable and filterable file list, and in-app preview of Office and code files.
